text:
### Compliance & Regulatory Documents  
| Document Type | Retention Period | Legal Basis |
|---|---|---|
| **Complaint Files** | 6 years from resolution | FCA COBS Part 2 |
| **Regulatory Reports** | 5 years | PRA Rulebook, audit |
| **AML Screening Results** | 5 years post-closure | Money Laundering Regs |
| **SAR (Suspicious Activity)** | 5 years | Proceeds of Crime Act |
| **Audit Reports** | 7 years | Statutory audit |
| **Board/Committee Minutes** | Permanent | Corporate governance |
| **Compliance Bulletins** | 3 years | Regulatory reference |
| **Regulatory Circulars** | 3–5 years | Regulatory guidance |
name: Chunk 7/24

raw_entities.name: Document Retention Policy
raw_entities.description: A policy governing the retention periods and legal bases for maintaining compliance and regulatory documents. The policy specifies distinct retention periods ranging from 3 to 7 years for various document types, with permanent retention for board and committee minutes. Legal basis is derived from FCA, PRA, and statutory audit requirements.
context: Compliance & Regulatory Documents | Document Type | Retention Period | Legal Basis
Complaint Files | 6 years from resolution | FCA COBS Part 2
Board/Committee Minutes | Permanent | Corporate governance

raw_entities.name: Complaint File Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Complaint files must be retained for 6 years from the date of resolution. This requirement is mandated under FCA COBS Part 2 and ensures adequate documentation of complaint handling and resolution.
context: Complaint Files | 6 years from resolution | FCA COBS Part 2

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Report Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Regulatory reports must be retained for 5 years. This requirement is based on PRA Rulebook and audit obligations to maintain evidence of regulatory compliance and reporting.
context: Regulatory Reports | 5 years | PRA Rulebook, audit

raw_entities.name: AML Screening Results Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: AML screening results must be retained for 5 years following account closure. This requirement is mandated under the Money Laundering Regulations to maintain audit trails of anti-money laundering compliance.
context: AML Screening Results | 5 years post-closure | Money Laundering Regs

raw_entities.name: SAR Filing Record Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Suspicious Activity Report records must be retained for 5 years. This requirement is mandated under the Proceeds of Crime Act to maintain documentation of suspicious activity reporting obligations.
context: SAR (Suspicious Activity) | 5 years | Proceeds of Crime Act

raw_entities.name: Audit Report Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Audit reports must be retained for 7 years. This requirement is based on statutory audit obligations to maintain evidence of internal and external audit activities.
context: Audit Reports | 7 years | Statutory audit

raw_entities.name: Board and Committee Minutes Permanent Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Board and committee minutes must be retained permanently. This requirement is mandated under corporate governance principles to maintain a permanent record of governance decisions and deliberations.
context: Board/Committee Minutes | Permanent | Corporate governance

raw_entities.name: Compliance Bulletin Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Compliance bulletins must be retained for 3 years. This requirement is based on regulatory reference obligations to maintain documentation of regulatory guidance and compliance communications.
context: Compliance Bulletins | 3 years | Regulatory reference

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Circular Retention Requirement
raw_entities.description: Regulatory circulars must be retained for 3 to 5 years. This requirement is based on regulatory guidance obligations to maintain documentation of regulatory communications and directives.
context: Regulatory Circulars | 3–5 years | Regulatory guidance

raw_entities.name: Financial Conduct Authority COBS Part 2
raw_entities.description: FCA Conduct of Business sourcebook Part 2 establishes requirements for complaint handling and documentation. This regulation mandates the 6-year retention period for complaint files from resolution.
context: Complaint Files | 6 years from resolution | FCA COBS Part 2

raw_entities.name: PRA Rulebook
raw_entities.description: The PRA Rulebook establishes prudential requirements for regulated firms. It mandates the 5-year retention period for regulatory reports.
context: Regulatory Reports | 5 years | PRA Rulebook, audit

raw_entities.name: Money Laundering Regulations
raw_entities.description: The Money Laundering Regulations establish anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing obligations for financial institutions. They mandate the 5-year post-closure retention period for AML screening results.
context: AML Screening Results | 5 years post-closure | Money Laundering Regs

raw_entities.name: Proceeds of Crime Act
raw_entities.description: The Proceeds of Crime Act establishes the legal framework for reporting suspicious activity and money laundering. It mandates the 5-year retention period for Suspicious Activity Report records.
context: SAR (Suspicious Activity) | 5 years | Proceeds of Crime Act

raw_entities.name: Money Laundering
raw_entities.description: Money laundering risk is addressed through AML screening and SAR filing obligations, with records retained for 5 years post-closure to maintain audit trails and compliance evidence.
context: AML Screening Results | 5 years post-closure | Money Laundering Regs
SAR (Suspicious Activity) | 5 years | Proceeds of Crime Act

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Compliance Risk
raw_entities.description: Regulatory compliance risk is mitigated through retention of regulatory reports, audit reports, and compliance bulletins to maintain evidence of adherence to FCA, PRA, and statutory audit requirements.
context: Regulatory Reports | 5 years | PRA Rulebook, audit
Audit Reports | 7 years | Statutory audit
Compliance Bulletins | 3 years | Regulatory reference

raw_entities.name: AML Screening Results
raw_entities.description: AML screening results document the outcomes of anti-money laundering checks performed on customer accounts. Results must be retained for 5 years following account closure to maintain compliance evidence under the Money Laundering Regulations.
context: AML Screening Results | 5 years post-closure | Money Laundering Regs

raw_entities.name: Suspicious Activity Report Filing
raw_entities.description: Suspicious Activity Reports document and report suspicious transactions or activities to the relevant authority. SAR records must be retained for 5 years under the Proceeds of Crime Act.
context: SAR (Suspicious Activity) | 5 years | Proceeds of Crime Act
